heroHeadline: Bad Bunny Unveils Aged Future Self at 2026 Met Gala; Stars in Adidas World Cup Campaign with Messi & Chalamet; European Tour Opens May 22 Barcelona
heroSubtitle: Tracking the rise from SoundCloud uploads in Vega Baja to 100 billion Spotify streams, a historic Super Bowl LX halftime performance, and Grammy Album of the Year. Bad Bunny's 2026 Met Gala look — a hyper-realistic transformation into an aged future self via Oscar-winning makeup artist Mike Marino and a custom Zara tuxedo responding to the 'Aging Body' theme — generated viral global coverage on May 4–5, including a widely shared hug with Kris Jenner on the red carpet. On May 6, Adidas dropped a cinematic FIFA World Cup 2026 campaign starring Bad Bunny alongside Lionel Messi, Timothée Chalamet, David Beckham, and Zinedine Zidane. The record-breaking 'DtMF' holds 57 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on the Hot Latin Songs chart — the longest run in the chart's 60+ year history, surpassing 'Despacito.' The European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opens May 22 in Barcelona (Estadi Olímpic, two sold-out nights), then Lisbon and Madrid.
footerNote: Data sourced from Rimas Entertainment, Billboard, Spotify Newsroom, RIAA, Latin Recording Academy, Recording Academy, Pollstar, Adidas Newsroom, The Hollywood Reporter, Variety, Bloomberg, NPR, Remezcla, Deadline, Complex, Bleacher Report, Rolling Stone, and major media
